sources.title: How much does it cost to replace a bathtub or shower drain? [2026 data]
sources.supports: Drain replacement $500–$1,020 (average $700); extra $1,350–$6,100 where drywall/unclogging/water damage is involved; drywall about $2,100 when a wall is opened; unclogging $225.

sources.title: How much does bathroom leak repair cost? [2026 data]
sources.supports: Leak repair $150–$600 (average $275); drywall/tile add-ons $300–$930; labour $45–$200/hour; call-out $50–$200; hidden pipes or significant water damage up to $4,000.

sources.title: How to replace a tub drain
sources.supports: Below-tub access for stubborn drains; cutting out an old drain from below in extreme cases; the role of the overflow as a safety feature.
